text: Silver gives us clean, trustworthy delivery events. Support reps don't want history, though -- they want one answer: where is this package right now. This video builds Gold.
package_status_gold holds one row per package. Latest, in this first version, means whichever event landed in Bronze most recently. delivery_performance_gold rolls up daily performance.
A row_number window, partitioned by package_id, ordered by kafka_ingest_timestamp descending, picks the current status -- the simplest rule to reach for, and usually the right answer.

delivery_performance_gold joins delivered events against each package's promised delivery date, computing on-time rate and average transit time -- a daily batch job, ready for Fabric and Power BI later.
One governed current status per package now exists. Next: hardening the Kafka streaming job itself into something that survives a real production restart.
